title: Negative scenario — a ROLLBACK that exits 0 without removing what it created
description: Harness self-proof: the ROLLBACK drops the right function name with the wrong argument list, so every statement returns 0 while the function survives. This is the defect that shipped twice in migrations 47-51. The catalog symmetry check (baseline before apply vs catalog after rollback) must fail the run with the rollback exit code (30). Registered as an expect-failure fixture; ci:runtime treats an unexpected PASS as a hard failure, so the symmetry check cannot be silently weakened or removed.
